patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,117 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.current_frame = 1
+        self.frame_rolls = 0  # Number of rolls in current frame
+        self.is_finished = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.is_finished:
+            raise ValueError("game already finished")
+        
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("pins cannot be negative")
+            
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        
+        # Validate roll based on game state
+        if self.current_frame < 10:
+            # Regular frames (1-9)
+            if self.frame_rolls == 1 and self.rolls and self.rolls[-1] != 10:
+                # Second roll of a frame (not a strike previously)
+                if self.rolls[-1] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        else:
+            # 10th frame validation
+            if self.frame_rolls == 0:
+                # First roll of 10th frame - no special validation needed
+                pass
+            elif self.frame_rolls == 1:
+                # Second roll of 10th frame
+                if self.rolls[-1] == 10:
+                    # First roll was a strike, second roll can be anything
+                    pass
+                else:
+                    # First roll wasn't a strike, check total
+                    if self.rolls[-1] + pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            elif self.frame_rolls == 2:
+                # Third roll of 10th frame (fill ball)
+                if self.rolls[-2] == 10 and self.rolls[-1] == 10:
+                    # First two were strikes, third can be anything
+                    pass
+                elif self.rolls[-2] == 10:
+                    # First was strike, second wasn't, check second and third
+                    if self.rolls[-1] + pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                elif self.rolls[-2] + self.rolls[-1] == 10:
+                    # First two were a spare, third can be anything
+                    pass
+                else:
+                    # Shouldn't get here - game should be finished
+                    raise ValueError("invalid fill balls")
+        
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # Handle frame progression
+        if self.current_frame < 10:
+            # Regular frames (1-9)
+            if pins == 10:  # Strike
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                self.frame_rolls = 0
+            else:
+                self.frame_rolls += 1
+                if self.frame_rolls == 2:
+                    self.current_frame += 1
+                    self.frame_rolls = 0
+        else:
+            # 10th frame handling
+            self.frame_rolls += 1
+            
+            # Determine if game is finished
+            if self.frame_rolls == 2:
+                # If first two rolls are not a strike or spare, game is over
+                if self.rolls[-2] + self.rolls[-1] < 10:
+                    self.is_finished = True
+            elif self.frame_rolls == 3:
+                # Game is always over after 3 rolls in 10th frame
+                self.is_finished = True
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.is_finished:
+            raise ValueError("game not yet finished")
+            
+        score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        # Score frames 1-9
+        for frame in range(9):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                raise ValueError("game not yet finished")
+                
+            if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:  # Strike
+                if roll_index + 2 >= len(self.rolls):
+                    raise ValueError("game not yet finished")
+                score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 1] + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                # Check if we have enough rolls for a non-strike frame
+                if roll_index + 1 >= len(self.rolls):
+                    raise ValueError("game not yet finished")
+                    
+                frame_score = self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                if frame_score == 10:  # Spare
+                    if roll_index + 2 >= len(self.rolls):
+                        raise ValueError("game not yet finished")
+                    score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                else:  # Open frame
+                    score += frame_score
+                roll_index += 2
+        
+        # Score 10th frame (just sum all rolls in 10th frame)
+        tenth_frame_start = len(self.rolls) - self.frame_rolls
+        for i in range(tenth_frame_start, len(self.rolls)):
+            score += self.rolls[i]
+                
+        return score
